name: BH Telecom Data Centar (kolokacija + DR)
notes: Official operator page (published 01.09.2019, checked 2026-08-12): Data Centar described as primary disaster-recovery site in BiH offering colocation with racks, cooling, uninterrupted power, direct user links and managed services; fitted to TIER 3 standard (99.982% availability, N+1), ISO 9001:2015 and ISO/IEC 27001:2013 certified. Located in Sarajevo (FBiH); exact municipality/address not stated on page.

name: BH Telecom modular data centre (MDC) Sarajevo
notes: SeeNews (12 Sep 2023) and Indikator.ba (8 Sep 2023): BH Telecom launched a tender for construction works on a modular data centre (MDC) in Sarajevo, Opcina Novi Grad, including design and permit-procurement services; DC intended to consolidate servers and be largely rented to businesses and institutions. No public evidence of completion or operation found in Aug 2026 checks, so kept at planned/tender stage.

name: BH Telecom-AWS sovereign cloud (service MoU)
developer: BH Telecom d.d. Sarajevo / Amazon Web Services
notes: June 2025 MoU for a sovereign cloud for the BiH public sector with AWS; btw.media/TelecomReviewEurope report cloud services expected to launch from 2025. This is a service/partnership lead hosted in BH Telecom infrastructure, not a new standalone hyperscale facility; no AWS BiH public region exists in official AWS region lists.

name: HT Eronet Data Centar (georedundant)
developer: JP Hrvatske telekomunikacije d.d. Mostar (HT Eronet)
notes: Official operator pages (checked 2026-08-12): HT Eronet offers use of a georedundant data centre plus server colocation with redundant cooling/power, reachable via internet or direct HT Eronet network infrastructure. Operator-service evidence for a Mostar (Herzegovina-Neretva Canton, FBiH) facility; site-specific permit/construction records not separately located.

name: Globalhost Data Center
notes: Company-site evidence (checked 2026-08-12): Globalhost states it is the only web-hosting company in BiH owning its own Data Center (no resale on third-party infrastructure), located at Kralja Tvrtka 42, 72290 Novi Travnik (Central Bosnia Canton, FBiH); LinkedIn confirms Data Center/colocation activity since 2002. Address/permit confirmation before Grade A pending.

name: University of Tuzla data centre (concept)
developer: Univerzitet u Tuzli / Tuzla Canton Government
notes: Klix (3 Apr 2025): concept design for a University of Tuzla data centre presented to Tuzla Canton Government for digital networking of all institutions; Apr 2025 follow-up added a science-technology park concept. Concept stage only - no permit, tender or construction evidence as of Aug 2026.

name: Zenica old steelworks (Zeljezara) data centre proposal
notes: Political proposal (zenicablog, Jan 2026) to develop a data centre within the old Zeljezara Zenica complex; a LinkedIn post by a Vertiv staff member (2026) reports a 500,000 KM grant agreement to fund the project feasibility study. No government/planning decision or permit verified; graded C until primary confirmation.

name: LANACO Technology Center Data Center
notes: Official Technology Center site (checked 2026-08-12): the digital heart of the centre is a data centre claimed as the only one in BiH/region built to Tier 4 standard; centre founded 2014 and officially opened 2017, located in the Incel business zone 2.5 km from Banja Luka city centre. Company-site/opening evidence (Grade B); capacity figures (DataCenterMap lists 1 MW, Grade C) not independently verified.

name: Integra Data Centar (Integra Inzenjering d.o.o.)
notes: Company site integradc.net (checked 2026-08-12) confirms Integra Data Centar business centre and colocation/ISP services with Banja Luka contact numbers (+387 51). Commercial colo lead; building permit/address confirmation via Grad Banja Luka and e-Nabavke still pending before Grade A.

name: m:tel Virtual Data Center (service)
notes: m:tel offers a Virtual Data Center cloud service (VPS/NaaS) from its Banja Luka headquarters; per methodology this is a cloud-service product, not proof of a physical datacenter facility. No public address/permit evidence of a physical m:tel/Telekom Srpske data centre found; recorded as service lead only.

name: RS state data centre (plan, feasibility study)
developer: Sluzbeni glasnik Republike Srpske / RS government (contractor: Data Cloud Technology, Kragujevac)
notes: Detektor/BIRN BiH (14 May 2026): Sluzbeni glasnik RS awarded a 119,000 KM contract to Serbian state-owned Data Cloud Technology (Kragujevac) for a feasibility study for an RS state data centre modelled on Serbia Kragujevac DC; tender documentation requires operator experience with 10 MW+ data centres and EN 50600 class-4 certified facilities, envisions multiple regional sites. Site TBD; status planned until a location/permit/tender appears.

Targeted searches (BCS and English: Brcko distrikt data centar, Brcko server sala, centar podataka, kolokacija, district government and DERK/e-Nabavke surfaces) found no datacenter facility or project in Brcko District. Only municipal/government and utility references appear (e.g., Elektroprenos BiH investment plan lists internal Data centri/Server sala at company HQ and a TS 110/x kV Brcko 2 substation - grid infrastructure, not a datacenter). Expect at most small internal/municipal server rooms; no commercial colo identified.
